what_to_detect: An Aura whose quality matches a protection the enchanted permanent gained is put into the graveyard in the state-based check (an unresolved zone_change, battlefield to graveyard).
near_miss: An Aura that stays attached because the gained protection does not match its quality.
record_fields: resolution events keyword_change on the host

what_to_detect: An Aura that grants its host protection and states it does not remove itself stays attached, while the same protection from another source removes it.
near_miss: The Aura put into the graveyard because the host gained a matching protection from another source.
record_fields: resolution events keyword_change on the host

what_to_detect: A protection-granting effect whose text excepts its controller's Auras leaves those Auras attached while removing other matching Auras.
near_miss: An Aura of the quality that the same protection puts into the graveyard.
record_fields: resolution events keyword_change on the host
